decision_note: Prague pre-seed impact/healthtech VC (Fund I just under CZK 60m, closed Sep 2024 before the window; second fund PT Capital still raising) whose portfolio grew from 5 to 13 companies, but no investment or close dated on/after 2024-10-25 could be documented - unverified until a dated deal is found.

legal_entities.name: PurposeTech F1 s.r.o., osoba rizikového kapitálu

evidence.quote: PurposeTech is a pre-seed fund that backs founders reshaping Health, Climate, and the Future of Work.
We're about to start investing from our second HealthTech fund.

Prague-based venture capital firm PurposeTech has announced the closure for its first pre-seed fund, supporting Central and Eastern European founders focusing on health, sustainability, and education.
Necelých šedesát milionů korun měl na to, aby vybudoval první portfolio a ověřil svou investiční tezi.

Maximální velikost nového fondu PT Capital je deset milionů eur, tedy 240 milionů korun, přičemž první čtyři miliony eur má začít investovat během letošního podzimu a zbytek prostředků od investorů získat v následujících osmnácti měsících.
Jednu společnost se fond chystá podpořit částkou kolem půl až jednoho milionu eur u valuace pohybující se v průměru kolem dvou až tří milionů eur.
Během posledních dvou a půl let ve fondu analyzovali tři tisíce startupů a zainvestovali zatím jedenáct z nich jako například eNOugh nebo Tingit.
Its recent deals include €100,000 investment in Mamio and participation in Tingit’s €500,000 round.

Prague-based PurposeTech, a venture capital firm that supports Central and Eastern European founders, has closed its oversubscribed first pre-seed venture capital fund aimed at health, sustainability, and education startups across the CEE region, as reported to Vestbee.
With a presence in seven countries across the CEE region, PurposeTech has reviewed over 1,100 startups and made its first five investments.
2.5 years of investing 3,000+ startups reviewed 13 investments made

analyst_notes: Discovered via CzechCrunch (2026-02-10, second fund PT Capital). I3 rests on the PT Capital launch (2026-02-10; max EUR 10m / CZK 240m, first EUR 4m to be invested from autumn 2026) plus continued deployment of Fund I: 11 investments as of 2026-02-10 (CzechCrunch) vs '13 investments made' on the website now, implying further unnamed deals in 2026; no individual deal dated on/after 2024-10-25 was found in free sources (Tingit, Aug 2024, and Mamio, Jan 2024, predate the window). Ticket EUR 0.5-1m is the stated plan for PT Capital (fund II); fund I wrote smaller pre-seed tickets (directory profiles say EUR 25-250k, not cited). Capital = fund I 'just under CZK 60m' (recorded as 60m). Fund I close dated by AIN (2024-10-11, size undisclosed there). Fund II vehicle not yet in ARES ('PT Capital, s.r.o.', IČO 25835955 in Ostrava, is an unrelated 1999 company). Sector: website verticals Health, Climate, Future of Work (mapped to healthtech, energy_climate, software_saas); fund II narrows to healthtech. Tingit described by CzechCrunch (2024) as Lithuanian; eNOugh country not stated. [revision 2026-10-25 after review: decision include -> unverified (E8). I3 needs a dated in-window event: Fund I closed before the window (Vestbee 2024-09-25, e9; the fund event now carries that date instead of the later AIN article date) and PT Capital (2026-02-10) is only a fund still raising (launch). The portfolio grew from 5 investments at the Fund I close (e10) to 11 (CzechCrunch 2026-02-10, e7) and 13 now (website, e11: Auryx, eNOugh, Lifeyear, Tingit, Doc2Me, SafePAS, Willow, Mamio, KANO Care, Neya, Fether Labs, Dognosis, Amorphous AI), so at least six investments fell in the window, but none could be dated with a verbatim source naming PurposeTech: searches of the portfolio companies' sites and coverage (SafePAS EstBAN syndicate, Auryx, KANO Care, Dognosis) did not name PurposeTech; PitchBook (paywalled, not citable) reportedly lists SafePAS Jun 2025, KANO Care Dec 2025 and Auryx Apr 2026. I1/I2/I4 are met; re-screen when one of these deals can be dated. Ticket: now the observed Fund I ticket - EUR 100k into Mamio (e8, one observed deal, labelled derived); the EUR 0.5-1m in e6 is the PLANNED ticket of the second fund PT Capital (not yet investing), and directory profiles put Fund I tickets at about EUR 25-250k (not cited).]
